package rulefixtures

import (
	"net/http"
	"regexp"

	"github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
)

// scenario for middleware_allocates_regex_or_template_per_request: Regexp compilation inside Gin handlers instead of using precompiled patterns.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: gin; severity: contextual.

func RegexCompileMiddleware() gin.HandlerFunc {
	return func(c *gin.Context) {
		email := c.Query("email")
		pattern := regexp.QuoteMeta(email)
		re, err := regexp.Compile("^" + pattern + "$")
		if err != nil {
			c.AbortWithStatusJSON(http.StatusBadRequest, gin.H{"error": "invalid regex"})
			return
		}

		username := c.Query("username")
		if re.MatchString(username) {
			c.AbortWithStatusJSON(http.StatusOK, gin.H{"match": true})
			return
		}
		c.Next()
	}
}

var _ = regexp.Compile
